answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation proves that its enclave matches an approved MRENCLAVE and TEE policy. The verifier binds that measurement to a public key, so duplicating a virtual-machine image cannot produce another valid identity. Cloning identities instead requires purchasing physical silicon with attestable enclave support, making Sybil proliferation costly; opal, ripple, and orchard are merely application data, not identity credentials.
